name: polish_red_autumn
description: A modern Polish political total-conversion prototype built with DendryNexus.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.smoke: npm run check-events && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:radio: npm run build && DSS_RADIO_SMOKE=1 node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:burden: npm run build && DSS_BURDEN_SMOKE=1 node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:braun: npm run build && DSS_BRAUN_SMOKE=1 node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:senate: npm run build && DSS_SENATE_SMOKE=1 node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.smoke:phase7: npm run build && DSS_PHASE7_SMOKE=1 node scripts/smoke-test.js

author: DSS Poland contributors; based on a game by Autumn Chen
